verdict.rationale: turbopuffer's own docs describe testing with isolated per-test namespaces. It can also branch a namespace into an instant copy-on-write clone, or copy one server-side, so tests can run on a copy of production data without modifying the original. However, these are namespace-level isolation patterns, each evidenced by a single line, rather than a dedicated sandbox environment. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or test-mode environment, test-scoped API keys or access separation from production, in-depth testing docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
